clauses.clause_label: 1.1–1.2 Non-Commercial Use License and Attribution Requirement
clauses.scope_note: License to use, reproduce, modify, and distribute Repository content (Licensed Material); worldwide, royalty-free, non-exclusive, and non-transferable. Applies only for non-commercial purposes and subject to the stated credit requirements.
clauses.condition_explanation: Use must be for a non-commercial purpose. When using or distributing the material, the licensee must cite the Licensor's name, link to the Repository, and indicate whether changes were made.

clauses.clause_label: 1.3 and 2.1–2.2 Commercial Use Restriction and Reservation
clauses.actor_role: licensee; Licensor for the reserved commercial rights
clauses.scope_note: Licensees are prohibited from commercial use without the Licensor's prior explicit written consent. Commercial rights are reserved exclusively to the Licensor, who retains the sole right to use, reproduce, modify, distribute, and sublicense the Licensed Material commercially. Interested parties must obtain explicit written consent; the clause directs requests to contact information at the agreement's end.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies when the purpose is commercial and the Licensor has not given prior explicit written consent. The consent exception is not an unconditional commercial grant.

clauses.actor_role: Licensor, as grantee; Contributor, as grantor
clauses.scope_note: On submission of a Contribution to the Repository, the Contributor grants the Licensor an exclusive, perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, reproduce, modify, distribute, sublicense, and create derivative works from that Contribution for any purpose, including commercial purposes.
clauses.condition_explanation: The grant is triggered by submission of a Contribution. The clause states no further condition on the Licensor's grant of rights.

clauses.scope_note: A Contributor retains the right to use their own Contributions for non-commercial purposes under the same terms as the Agreement, including the attribution terms in 1.2.
clauses.condition_explanation: The retained right is limited to non-commercial purposes and remains subject to the Agreement's terms.

clauses.clause_label: 3.4 and 4.1 No Commercial Rights and Prohibition of Commercial Exploitation
clauses.scope_note: Licensees and Contributors may not use Licensed Material or Contributions commercially, distribute them as part of a commercial product or service, or sublicense them for commercial use. Contributors acknowledge they have no commercial-use rights in Licensed Material or their Contributions.
clauses.condition_explanation: These prohibitions apply to commercial-purpose use, distribution as part of a commercial product or service, and sublicensing for commercial use by a Licensee or Contributor. The separate Licensor grant in 3.1 and the commercial-rights reservation in 2.1 are not grants to these actors.

clauses.clause_label: 5.2–5.3 Termination for Breach and Effect of Termination
clauses.actor_role: Licensor for termination; Licensee or Contributor for post-termination destruction
clauses.scope_note: The Licensor may terminate immediately if a Licensee or Contributor breaches any Agreement term. Upon termination, all rights granted under the Agreement cease, and the Licensee or Contributor must destroy all copies of Licensed Material in their possession.
clauses.condition_explanation: Termination is available to the Licensor upon breach. Once termination occurs, the rights cease and the Licensee or Contributor must destroy possessed copies.

clauses.actor_role: Licensor for modifying terms; Licensee or Contributor for continued use
clauses.scope_note: The Licensor reserves the right to modify the Agreement at any time; continued use of the Repository constitutes acceptance of modified terms.
clauses.condition_explanation: The stated acceptance consequence applies when Repository use continues after the Agreement is modified.

coverage_notes: The text describes content of a Repository as Licensed Material but does not specify its contents or distinguish repository material from third-party dependencies; the extracted permissions are limited to the defined Licensed Material and Contributions.
Commercial permission requires prior explicit written consent; the text does not provide a separate commercial license or its terms.
The Contributor originality and non-infringement warranty in 3.3 concerns Contributions but does not itself grant or restrict an allowed listed activity.
No source-provision, copyleft, patent, training, network-service, output-rights, or fee provisions appear in the supplied text.
